description:
Modern Windows desktop application for managing and hosting local Minecraft Java and Bedrock servers.

PocketMC is a native WPF/.NET 8 desktop app for local Minecraft server hosting. It handles software downloads, isolated instances, managed Java and PHP runtimes, live metrics, logs, backups, cloud replication, Playit.gg tunnels, add-ons, and a remote web dashboard.
- Eliminated background auto-deletion of unrecognized or incompatible mods and plugins
- Added interactive user-controlled cleanup banner on the Add-ons page
- Added specific diagnostic dialogs for local add-on imports with override options
- Streamlined add-on cards with a single lightweight warning icon badge and tooltip
- Fixed Velopack delta update size reporting in UpdateService
- Restored Windows auto-hide taskbar functionality when PocketMC is maximized
